intro: Rhinag is an afflicted jungle troll seeking shelter within a modest homestead at Rocktusk Farm in Durotar. Paralyzed by the harsh venom of the region's scorpions, he relies entirely on passing travelers to secure him a timely remedy.

p: While traversing the arid terrain of Durotar, Rhinag fell victim to the vicious sting of a local Venomtail Scorpid. Overwhelmed by the potent poison, he managed to drag himself into the dilapidated shelter at Rocktusk Farm. Incapacitated and isolated, his survival hinges on anyone who happens by with the resolve to procure a venomtail antidote before the toxins take their final toll.
